simple.summary: בֵּית הַשִּׁטָּה (Bêyth hash-Shiṭṭâh) means Beth-hash-Shittah , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Judg 7 22.

definitions.full: H1029. Beth Hashshittah הַשִּׁטָּה בֵּית proper name, of a location ( place of the acacia ) Judg 7:22 (on site compare Rob BR ii. 356 ).
definitions.rootNote: from 1004 and 7848 with the article interposed; house of the acacia;
